bug_info.bug_desc: In the old code, the TL-UL memory grant path was not gated by local_esc. The local escalation condition (escalation, bus integrity error, initialization error, or latched fatal status) set sram_intg_error but did not stall/block the bus handshake, so memory accesses could still be granted during a terminal security blocking state. The specification requires memory bus accesses to be blocked once such a state is entered.
bug_info.fix_hint: Qualify tlul_gnt with the local escalation condition as well as init_req so that when local_esc is asserted the TL-UL adapter is stalled and no new SRAM transactions are granted. This matches the blocking behavior already provided for global escalation via key_valid.
